If exploited: Gain initial access at Tenant Users. Access API Gateway via the initial entry point. Move from API Gateway to Rate Limiter. Move from Rate Limiter to Tenant Router. Reach target Tenant Config DB — exfiltrate, encrypt, or disrupt. Corroborated: user journey matches attack path.
